scope: Automatic caption tail-following and conservative recovery of pathological repeated recognition. No private audio exported; fixed media and real Qwen used for verification.

newCoverage: Long loops are unconfirmed; normal repeated emphasis and cumulative snapshots remain correct
Full 16/48 kHz clip boundaries, missing or expired audio, 40 second clip without held-speech truncation
One recovery per event, bounded queue, timeout, close rejects late results
finish waits for corrected-result delivery before returning
ASR requests omit forced language and translate only confirmed French or Chinese
Untruncated compact/full tail following, same-turn growth, manual pause, native accessibility and latest button

reliability.skipReason: The previously inspected personal anomaly no longer exists in current history. No text was recreated or exported.

failuresNotDiscarded.failure: French completed, following Chinese had no new final caption within 30 seconds
No final French caption within 30 seconds

crossApplication.interpretation: Capture received sound, but original failing runs lack per-turn gated-audio and provider-event counters. Root cause remains undetermined. Later passing replay does not close these failures.

limitations: Historical screenshot confirmed repetition in stored recognition, but old raw audio was not saved
Actual private WhatsApp voice message not replayed
Repetition detection is not a general detector for all wrong translations
Independent recovery is bounded to one complete clip up to 60 seconds within a 90 second memory ring, with at most two pending clips
Two intermittent missing-caption runs remain open despite later success
No natural-room or quiet acoustic duplex certification in this release
